title: Solar Hub
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/gen2"))()

local window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Solar Hub V1",
    Subtitle = "Script hub made using Rayfield",
})

-- Main Scripts Tab
local tab = window:CreateTab({
    Name = "Main Scripts",
    Icon = 93364949241311
})

-- States
local chargeEnabled = false
local highJumpEnabled = false
local godmodeEnabled = false
local noclipEnabled = false
local flyEnabled = false

local noclipConnection
local flyConnection
local flyVelocity
local flyGyro

--------------------------------------------------
-- Run Fast
--------------------------------------------------

tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Run fast",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        chargeEnabled = value

        if value then
            task.spawn(function()
                while chargeEnabled do
                    local character = player.Character
                    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 120
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                end

                local character = player.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if humanoid then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- Super Jump
--------------------------------------------------

tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Super Jump",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        highJumpEnabled = value

        if value then
            task.spawn(function()
                while highJumpEnabled do
                    local character = player.Character
                    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
                        humanoid.JumpPower = 300
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                end

                local character = player.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if humanoid then
                    humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
                    humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- God Mode
--------------------------------------------------

tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "God mode",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        godmodeEnabled = value

        if value then
            task.spawn(function()
                while godmodeEnabled do
                    local character = player.Character
                    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.MaxHealth = math.huge
                        humanoid.Health = math.huge
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            end)
        else
            local character = player.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if humanoid then
                humanoid.MaxHealth = 100
                humanoid.Health = 100
            end
        end
    end
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- Noclip
--------------------------------------------------

tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Noclip",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        noclipEnabled = value

        if noclipConnection then
            noclipConnection:Disconnect()
            noclipConnection = nil
        end

        if value then
            noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                local character = player.Character

                if character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        else
            local character = player.Character

            if character then
                for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- Fly
--------------------------------------------------

tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Fly",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        flyEnabled = value

        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        -- Turn Fly OFF
        if not value then

            if flyConnection then
                flyConnection:Disconnect()
                flyConnection = nil
            end

            if flyVelocity then
                flyVelocity:Destroy()
                flyVelocity = nil
            end

            if flyGyro then
                flyGyro:Destroy()
                flyGyro = nil
            end

            if humanoid then
                humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            end

            return
        end

        -- Make sure character exists
        if not rootPart or not humanoid then
            return
        end

        -- Create flight velocity
        flyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        flyVelocity.Name = "SolarFlyVelocity"
        flyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
            math.huge,
            math.huge,
            math.huge
        )
        flyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        flyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

        -- Create flight gyro
        flyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        flyGyro.Name = "SolarFlyGyro"
        flyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(
            math.huge,
            math.huge,
            math.huge
        )
        flyGyro.P = 10000
        flyGyro.Parent = rootPart

        humanoid.PlatformStand = true

        -- Flight loop
        flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not flyEnabled then
                return
            end

            local currentCharacter = player.Character
            local currentHumanoid = currentCharacter
                and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local currentRoot = currentCharacter
                and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if not currentRoot or not currentHumanoid then
                return
            end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if not camera then
                return
            end

            local direction = Vector3.zero

            -- Forward / Backward
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
            end

            -- Left / Right
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
            end

            -- Up
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end

            -- Down
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
                direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end

            if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                direction = direction.Unit
            end

            if flyVelocity and flyVelocity.Parent then
                flyVelocity.Velocity = direction * 80
            end

            if flyGyro and flyGyro.Parent then
                flyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
            end
        end)
    end
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- Sliders Tab
--------------------------------------------------

local sliderTab = window:CreateTab({
    Name = "Sliders (For exact Number)",
    Icon = 93364949241311
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- FOV Slider
--------------------------------------------------

sliderTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "FOV",
    Range = {1, 1000},
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = 90,

    Callback = function(value)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if camera then
            camera.FieldOfView = value
        end
    end
})

-- Set initial FOV
if workspace.CurrentCamera then
    workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 90
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- Exact Speed Slider
--------------------------------------------------

sliderTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Exact Speed",
    Range = {1, 120},
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = 16,

    Callback = function(value)
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = value
        end
    end
})

-- Set initial Speed
local character = player.Character
local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

if humanoid then
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- JumpPower Slider
--------------------------------------------------

sliderTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "JumpPower",
    Range = {50, 1000},
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = 50,

    Callback = function(value)
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if humanoid then
            humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
            humanoid.JumpPower = value
        end
    end
})

-- Set initial JumpPower
character = player.Character
humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

if humanoid then
    humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
    humanoid.JumpPower = 50
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- Auto Mechanics Tab
--------------------------------------------------

local mechanicsTab = window:CreateTab({
    Name = "Auto Mechanics",
    Icon = 93364949241311
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- Auto Jump
--------------------------------------------------

mechanicsTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Jump",
    CurrentValue = false,

    Callback = function(value)
        if value then
            task.spawn(function()
                while value do
                    local character = player.Character
                    local humanoid = character
                        and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.Jump = true
                    end

                    task.wait(0.2)

                    -- Stop if toggle is turned off
                    local toggleState = false
                    -- Rayfield handles the UI state; loop ends on next callback
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})
